text: GitHub Copilot was first announced on what date?
explanation: It is a code completion assistant for Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio, Neovim, Eclipse and the JetBrains IDEs, built by GitHub with OpenAI. It shipped two years before ChatGPT, which makes it a useful reminder that coding assistants were quietly the first mainstream AI product.

text: Runway AI is a New York company best known for which product category?
explanation: Video, images and other multimedia, through commercial text to video and video generative models. It is one of a cluster of companies, along with Stability AI and Midjourney, that turned generative research into tools filmmakers and designers actually pay for.

text: ElevenLabs, founded in 2022, specialises in which area of AI?
explanation: Speech, and it was founded by Piotr Dąbkowski and Mateusz Staniszewski, who both worked on speech at Google. The company is based in London with offices in New York, Warsaw and San Francisco, which is an unusual arrangement for a company founded by two Polish entrepreneurs and incorporated in the US.

text: Sora, previewed by OpenAI in February 2024, became generally available to which users first?
explanation: Sora generates text to video, and it reached paying ChatGPT subscribers before it reached anyone else. The rollout was staggered by tier and then by region through 2024, which is why a model previewed in February was still gated months later.

text: Google's NotebookLM was renamed in 2025. What is it now called?
explanation: Gemini Notebook, with LM standing for Language Model, and it is a retrieval augmented research and note taking tool. It answers only from documents you give it and cites them, which is the product form that RAG actually looks like when it is aimed at people rather than engineers.

text: What does the LM in the name NotebookLM stand for?
explanation: Language Model, which is the only technical term in the product name. The rest of the name describes what the tool does, which is reading your notes back to you with citations, and the abbreviation is a small joke aimed at people who would recognise it.

text: Which startup launched the screenless AI Pin wearable that flopped in 2024?
explanation: Humane, founded by ex-Apple staffers, shipped the screenless AI Pin in 2024 to dismal reviews over heat, battery and hallucinations. Rabbit is the tempting miss because its R1 flopped the same year, but the pin was Humane's. HP bought most of the company in early 2025 and shut the device down.

text: Which device unveiled at CES in January 2024 promised a large action model that operates apps for you?
explanation: Rabbit unveiled the 199-dollar R1 at CES in January 2024, promising a large action model that clicks through apps for you. The Apple Vision Pro is the tempting miss as the other hyped early-2024 gadget, but the action-model pitch was Rabbit's. Reviewers found a half-baked assistant and called it barely reviewable.

text: Which image service runs through Discord after entering open beta in July 2022?
explanation: Midjourney entered open beta in July 2022 as a bot living entirely inside Discord. Stable Diffusion is the tempting miss because it also arrived that summer, but it runs anywhere while Midjourney stayed Discord-only. Founder David Holz had previously built the Leap Motion controller.

text: Which NotebookLM feature that turns documents into podcast-style chats went viral in September 2024?
explanation: NotebookLM's Audio Overviews, which turn uploaded documents into a two-host podcast chat, went viral in September 2024. Mind Maps is the tempting miss as another NotebookLM view, but the 2024 sensation was audio. Fans shared clips of synthetic hosts bantering over meeting notes and syllabi.

text: Which label had the AI track Heart on My Sleeve pulled from streaming in April 2023?
explanation: The April 2023 track Heart on My Sleeve used AI-cloned vocals of Drake and The Weeknd, and Universal Music Group had it pulled from streaming. Sony Music is the tempting miss as another major label, but UMG acted because both mimicked artists sit on its roster. The anonymous maker ghostwriter still submitted the track for Grammy consideration.

text: How many users did ChatGPT gain in its first two months after launching in November 2022?
explanation: ChatGPT reached about 100 million users within two months of its November 2022 launch, the fastest consumer ramp on record then. Fifty million is the tempting undercount, but outside trackers put the two-month figure at 100 million. UBS analysts called it the fastest-growing consumer app in history.
